dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I'm in the market for a new pair of shoes. I'm looking to spend between $200 and $500 on some shoes that are both cute and good for running. I want shoes with at least a 2 out of 5 star average rating, and I do care about the reviews, even though I don't need a ton of them. Can you tell me about any shoes you have that might fit what I'm looking for?
dialogue.agent:
Based on your preferences, here are a couple of options I can recommend:

**Salomon Women's Supercross Blast GTX W Trail Running** - This shoe has an average rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars based on 1 review. It's priced at $252.95 and is a waterproof and comfortable trail running shoe.

**APL: Athletic Propulsion Labs Women's Techloom Breeze Sneakers** - These shoes have an average rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars based on 7 reviews. They are priced at $220 and are high-tech running shoes designed to help take your running to the next level.

Both of these options seem to match what you are looking for in terms of price range, rating, and being suitable for running. Let me know if you would like me to provide any additional details on these shoes or if you have any other questions!

products.title: Salomon Women's Supercross Blast GTX W Trail Running
products.description: Inspired by the legendary SPEEDCROSS, this shoe gives you the extra grip and protection you need to run fast and fearlessly. Whatever your playground, whatever the conditions, the SUPERCROSS BLAST GTX helps you push your limits. The shoe is fully waterproof (Gore-Tex) and really comfy with a soft lining, generous fit and spongy foam.

products.title: APL: Athletic Propulsion Labs Women's Techloom Breeze Sneakers
products.description: Want to take your run to the next level? APL: Athletic Propulsion Labs's high-tech Breeze running shoes will help you do just that—endorphin rush not included.

dialogue.user: Okay, those both sound like potentially good options. Can you tell me a bit more about the key features and benefits of each shoe? I want to make sure they'll really meet my needs for both style and performance.
dialogue.agent:
The key features of the **Salomon Women's Supercross Blast GTX W Trail Running** shoes are:

- Fully waterproof with Gore-Tex technology
- Designed for comfort with a soft lining, generous fit, and spongy foam
- Extra grip and protection for running fast and fearlessly on any terrain

The key features of the **APL: Athletic Propulsion Labs Women's Techloom Breeze Sneakers** are:

- Lightweight, breathable textured knit upper
- Rubber sole with a flat profile
- Designed to help take your running to the next level

Both shoes seem well-suited for running, with features focused on comfort, grip, and performance. The Salomon shoes offer more water protection, while the APL shoes have a sleeker, minimalist style. Let me know if you have any other questions as you decide which pair might be the best fit!
